# cgap

Sovereign columnar/deductive compute substrate: fixed-width columnar frames (A04 CgapFrameHeader, 128 B), binary ontology slots (B-ONT), string-free deduction (BN3 binary N3), spoliation-enforced P28-SIL licensing, and an Arrow C Data Interface kernel family — all #![no_std] with zero external dependencies, exposed through four sovereign C-ABI entrypoints (admit / eval / commit / verify) and a cgap umbrella facade.
